result.summary: No critical breakage is visible. The main visual issue is abrupt clipping at the right edge of horizontally scrollable sections, which makes content appear cut off.

issues.description: The category chip row and “Fastest near you” carousel are abruptly clipped at the right viewport edge. A partial category pill and the truncated “Trattoria Picco…” card make the layout look accidentally cropped rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right-side padding and a clearer horizontal-scroll affordance. Ensure partially visible cards maintain readable titles, or truncate card text with an ellipsis within each card’s bounds.
